name: deck-guy
author: Pavan Ravipati
summary: Turns a call transcript or scoping notes into a short follow-up slide deck with a timeline, requests, and a mutual action plan.
starterPrompt: Turn these call notes into a concise follow-up deck. Highlight the agreed timeline, open questions, and next steps without inventing commitments.
usageNote: Use transcripts you have permission to share. Check names, dates, and commitments before presenting or sending the deck.
